cycleSardiniaEs.name: Price
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: The published price is based on a group of 10 participants. The final price per person may be adjusted depending on the final group size. For groups of more than 10 participants, the price per person will be reduced for everyone, while smaller groups may result in a price increase. Please contact us for a personalised quotation based on your group size and travel dates.

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Difficulty
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: Our e-bike tours are specially designed for recreational cyclists who enjoy discovering the region at a relaxed pace. These tours focus on enjoying the landscape, cultural heritage, and history of the area. Thanks to electric assistance, these routes are accessible to almost everyone with a basic  level of fitness. However, it's important to note that we divide the tours into three difficulty levels, based on distance and elevation gain. While the e-bike takes much of the physical effort out of cycling, longer distances or greater elevation can still make for a more challenging ride.
cycleSardiniaEs.text2: To participate in these cycling holidays, it’s important that you have a good basic fitness level, cycle regularly, and are comfortable shifting gears efficiently when climbing, this will greatly enhance your enjoyment on the road.
cycleSardiniaEs.text3: See Blog for more information “Cycle Grades Tour E-Bike”

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Group size
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: Our tours are designed for small groups to ensure a safe, enjoyable, and high-quality experience. A minimum of 6 participants is required to organize the tour. The maximum number of participants is 14, which allows us to provide attentive service, maintain safety on the road, and ensure a personalized experience throughout the tour.

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Tailor-made version
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: For private groups, our tours can be fully tailored to your needs and preferences. Whether you want to adjust the itinerary, choose specific accommodations, or select the tour dates, we can create a personalized experience just for your group. To get started, we will send you a simple form to fill out with your preferences and requirements. Once we receive it, we will work with you to design a tour that perfectly matches your group’s interests, pace, and style.

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Self-Guided Tours
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: Our tour can also be organized as a self-guided experience, allowing you to explore Granada at your own pace. In this case, we will provide you with all the necessary information, including detailed route notes, accommodation details, and any additional guidance to ensure a smooth trip

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Accommodations
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: For this tour, we have carefully selected Alquería de los Lentos, a charming rural hotel located in Nigüelas, approximately 15 minutes from Granada. Set in the beautiful Lecrín Valley, at the foothills of Sierra Nevada, this former 16th-century flour mill offers a peaceful retreat surrounded by gardens, olive groves and mountain scenery. With its authentic Andalusian character, welcoming atmosphere and beautiful natural setting, it is the perfect place to relax and enjoy the slower pace of life in southern Spain. We have chosen this special accommodation to offer you a more authentic experience. Please note: The hotel is located outside Granada, so independent visits to the city are not possible on cycling days. You will have the opportunity to explore Granada during your free day, when you can enjoy the city and its famous Alhambra at your own pace.

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Transport
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: On this tour, we provide private transportation to ensure smooth transfers and maximum flexibility. Montaraz uses its own 8-seat passenger vehicle and, when required for groups larger than seven participants, works with a trusted private transport company. Transportation is provided to take guests to the starting point of each itinerary and to collect them at the end of the ride.
cycleSardiniaEs.text2: The Montaraz 8-seat passenger car also serves as a support vehicle for safety and comfort. It is available if someone needs a rest, experiences fatigue, or requires assistance along the route.
cycleSardiniaEs.text3: We also arrange airport transfers at the beginning and end of the tour, allowing you to travel comfortably and enjoy the experience without logistical concerns.

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Flight Information
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: At the start of the tour, participants arrive either at the airport or trainstation in Málaga or Granada, where a private transfer will be waiting to take them to their hotel.

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Optional Activities
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: Some extra experiences need to be booked in advance, while others can be decided on the day, depending on how you feel.

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Dietary Requirements
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: There are no problems accommodating vegetarian or vegan diets on this tour. Please let us know in advance if you have specific dietary requirements, so that our accommodations and restaurants can prepare accordingly.

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Weather in Granada
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: Spring and autumn are the ideal seasons to explore Granada by bicycle. During these months, temperatures are comfortable, the landscapes are at their most colourful, and the weather is generally stable, making for enjoyable days on the bike.
cycleSardiniaEs.text2: Spring is one of the best times to cycle in Granada. Days are typically sunny and mild, with daytime temperatures ranging from 15°C to 25°C (59°F–77°F). March can still bring some cool mornings and occasional showers, while April and May are usually warm, green, and full of wildflowers. The snow-capped peaks of the Sierra Nevada provide a spectacular backdrop to the rides.
cycleSardiniaEs.text3: Cyclists should be prepared for cooler temperatures in the early morning, particularly on higher routes, and dress in layers that can be removed as the day warms up.
cycleSardiniaEs.text4: Autumn offers equally excellent cycling conditions. September remains warm, with temperatures often reaching 25°C to 30°C (77°F–86°F) during the day, while October and November bring more moderate temperatures between 15°C and 25°C (59°F–77°F). As in spring, mornings can be cool, especially in October and November, making layered clothing the best option for comfort throughout the day.
